description: Caller changes their mind from Dr. Sethi to Dr. Rao in the last turn.
turns: Dr. Sethi ke saath appointment chahiye tha.
Ek minute, Dr. Sethi nahi, Dr. Rao ke saath karna hai.

expected.notes: The last correction switches the doctor from Dr. Sethi to Dr. Rao. A naive agent might book with Dr. Sethi based on the first mention. The booking must be with Dr. Rao on 2026-10-08. Both doctors work on Thursdays.
